purpose: Test whether an actually implemented wave-geometry forecast can beat strong algorithmic baselines and EIA's published day-ahead demand forecast on untouched daily balancing-authority demand.
primary_hypothesis: The development-selected wave candidate has lower seasonal-MASE than every predeclared baseline on the common-intersection 2026 holdout panel.

source.product: Form EIA-930 daily demand and day-ahead demand forecast by balancing authority
source.credential_policy: Read EIA_API_KEY or EIA_API_KEY_PREMIUM from the environment. Never serialize, print, hash, or copy the credential.

panel.deduplication: One row per respondent, timezone, type, and period. Duplicate values must agree or be reported as a data-quality conflict.
panel.common_intersection: Primary comparisons use only target dates containing actual demand, EIA day-ahead forecast, and every algorithmic forecast.

split.rolling_rule: At target date t, algorithms may use actual observations through t-1 only. Hyperparameters and candidate identity may not change after development selection.

baselines.definition: Use EIA type DF for the same respondent, timezone, and target period.
Forecast the observed demand from exactly seven days before the target.
Forecast the most recent observed demand.
Two-state local-level/local-trend Kalman filter. Process and observation variances are deterministic functions of pre-origin first differences; no fitted holdout parameters.
Fourteen-lag autoregression fitted on at most 730 pre-origin observations after history-only standardization, with ridge lambda 1.0.
History-only linear detrending followed by five highest-amplitude nonzero Fourier modes and one-step extrapolation.

wave_candidates.definition: Ridge harmonic regression with fixed periods 7, 30.4375, and 365.25 days plus intercept and linear trend; maximum history 730 days; ridge lambda 0.0001.
Fit the same fixed seasonal oscillators on pre-origin history, then advance their actual phases one day with the Kuramoto equation using Euler integration and fixed coupling K=0.01 radians per step.
Fit the fixed seasonal oscillators, then apply a fixed beta=0.02 phase attraction toward the highest-amplitude oscillator before one-day reconstruction.
Ridge harmonic regression with fixed periods 7, 14, 30.4375, and 365.25 days plus pairwise nodal interaction terms; maximum history 730 days; ridge lambda 0.001.

selection.rule: Choose exactly one wave candidate with the lowest mean seasonal-MASE across all development forecasts. Ties break by lower mean absolute error, then candidate id.
selection.holdout_visibility: No holdout metric may participate in candidate selection, parameter choice, source inclusion, or tie breaking.

metrics.primary_definition: Absolute error divided by the mean absolute seven-day difference available in pre-origin history.

inference.paired_delta_direction: baseline seasonal-MASE minus selected-candidate seasonal-MASE; positive favors the candidate
inference.paired_units: Balancing-authority calendar months on common-intersection holdout dates
inference.bootstrap: 10,000 deterministic cluster-bootstrap draws resampling balancing authorities with replacement and retaining their months; seed 20260713
inference.sign_test: Exact two-sided sign test over nonzero balancing-authority-month mean deltas
inference.multiple_comparison_control: Holm correction across the selected candidate versus all six predeclared baselines
inference.source_robustness: Report the number of balancing authorities with positive mean skill and the worst balancing-authority regression.

execution_controls.network_action: Read-only HTTPS GET to the official EIA route only.

claim_boundary: This protocol can produce measured public-data software forecast evidence in native MWh. It cannot by itself establish field control, grid reliability improvement, realized savings, procurement acceptance, safety, external validation, trading edge, or an unbeatable claim.
